questions: What public engine type names the 32-byte local-player collision record?
Which shipped entities call the server wind setter and with what authored ranges?

findings.fact: C_BaseAnimating::InternalDrawModel is the sole client consumer of the four replicated wind floats.
findings.evidence: 0x10092970 reads entity +0x4f8, +0x4fc, +0x500 and +0x504 only inside the MDLHeader.Flags 0x400 draw branch.
findings.consequence: Wind is a cloth-render input, not an animation-channel or material parameter.

findings.fact: Retail computes a horizontal time-varying wind vector from angle, changes per second, and minimum/maximum speed.
findings.evidence: 0x10092970 uses sine/cosine for XY, a lazily filled 256-entry random table for interpolation, clamps speed to the replicated range, and leaves Z zero.
findings.consequence: A faithful replay needs the same time/noise phase in addition to the four networked values.

findings.fact: The client passes one optional 32-byte dynamic collision record derived from the local player together with wind.
findings.evidence: 0x10092970 derives position/orientation from the local player, stages radius-like float 18 and identifier 1, and calls VEngineModel006 slot +0x68.
findings.consequence: Garment/player interaction is distinct from model-authored capsule and sphere collision.

functions.label: c_baseanimating_internal_draw_model
functions.role: Gates cloth by header flag, computes wind, builds the local-player collision record, and submits both to VEngineModel006.
